description: Assign up to 25 findings to one organisation member, or clear their assignee, as the Findings page's bulk action does. Reports each finding as applied, skipped (already assigned) or failed, with the reason. Each assignment notifies the assignee and syncs connected issue trackers, like assign_finding. Assignee "odin" asks Odin to fix each one, as assign_finding does: each result says whether Odin started (applied), needs the person's confirmation in Odin (skipped, with confirmUrl) or couldn't start (failed, with code and message). Requires an explicit user request and the Member role or above. Requires write permission.

assigneeUserId.description: The member to assign, from list_finding_mentionables, "odin" to assign Odin (it drafts each fix), or null to clear the assignee.

findingIds.description: findingId values (not identifiers such as ODI-12) from list_findings or get_finding.

name: assign_findings
title: Assign several findings
